tagline: Local experts in outdoor power equipment and Weber BBQs
heroSubheading: Everything for your garden and outdoor entertaining
aboutHtml:
We're Onkar and Sukhi Singh, and we run STIHL SHOP Botany. We stock everything from STIHL outdoor power equipment through to Masport, Honda Power Equipment, Rover, Cub Cadet, Wolf Garten, Hansa Chippers, Silky, and Weber BBQs. Whether you're looking to upgrade your lawn mower, hedgetrimmer, brushcutter, or grill, we've got the range.

We don't just sell equipment. We service and maintain it, too. Your purchases come assembled and ready to go, and we offer home delivery or click and collect to suit you. Our service centre handles all major brands, keeping your gear in top working order. We also provide advice on selecting the right tool for your needs, whether that's your garden or your entertaining space.

Locals come to us because we know our stuff and we stand behind what we sell. Come in and see us next to Mitre 10 Botany. We're open Monday to Friday 8:30am to 5pm, Saturday 9am to 4pm, and Sunday 10am to 4pm.
